description: Source code for MainWindow class in a WPF application, managing window state, WebView2 initialization, and WebView2 runtime installation prompts.

classes.name: MainWindow
classes.description: Main application window handling WebView2 setup, window state persistence, and WebView2 runtime installation.

methods.name: MainWindow
methods.description: Constructor initializing components, restoring window state, and setting up WebView.

methods.name: MainWindow_Loaded
methods.description: Event handler for window loaded event, activates window.

methods.name: PromptToInstallWebview2
methods.description: Prompts user to install WebView2 runtime if not present.

methods.name: Installer_InstallProgress
methods.description: Updates UI with WebView2 installation progress.

methods.name: Installer_InstallCompleted
methods.description: Handles completion of WebView2 installation, possibly restarting window.

methods.name: SaveWindowState
methods.description: Saves current window position, size, and state to settings.

methods.name: RestoreWindowsState
methods.description: Restores window position, size, and maximized state from settings.

methods.name: MainWindow_Closing
methods.description: Handles window closing event, saves window state.

methods.name: InitializeWebView
methods.description: Initializes WebView2 environment and loads URL, prompts for installation if needed.

methods.name: WebView_ContentLoading
methods.description: Sets session ID in WebView2 local storage when content loads.
